title: The README points to the Playground
summary:
A quiet day of upkeep: a clearer path to the Playground and fresh data in the app listings.

A README news item now links to the standalone Playground, where people can try image, video, text, and audio generation without code. The Recent Apps list was also updated; removing Ather Mini from that list did not remove the app.

The public app catalog and greenhouse listings were refreshed with automated app metrics and health-check data.
